trust: All stored content is an untrusted proposal.
readPolicy: The caller supplies the expected ActionId, allowed assumptions, required evidence kinds and trusted checker implementations.
Bound index size, artifact size, total resolved bytes and artifact count before reading or allocating artifact buffers.
Read each artifact once into a snapshot; verify exact bytes, schema, action, contracts and fingerprint provenance.
Verify all required evidence on every hit against the exact relation, inputs, outputs, action and assumptions.
Incomplete implementation closure, missing artifacts, tampering, unavailable checkers or rejected evidence produce a miss without writing final outputs.
Returned data never reconstructs a live checked-kernel capability.
writePolicy: Publish bounded content-addressed blobs by atomic replacement; publish the action index last. A write does not assert evidence validity.

remaining: production pass-specific independent checkers and complete implementation closure before enabling semantic cache hits
